source_text.body:
Process emails and compile weekly business metrics
Claude in Chrome handled 27 emails in about 3 minutes and runs a recurring Monday task compiling business metrics from several dashboards.
Done with
CH
Claude in Chrome
What they did
The reviewer used the Claude in Chrome extension for two tasks. For email, they asked it in plain language to find unread messages from the past week that asked for feedback and draft replies for their review. For reporting, they scheduled a workflow for Monday at 9 AM that pulls metrics from an analytics dashboard, a CRM and financial tools, then compiles a weekly summary.
How it went
It handled 27 emails in about 3 minutes, a job the reviewer says would take 30+ minutes by hand. The weekly report used to take 25-30 minutes and now runs automatically, which the reviewer estimates saves 20+ hours a year.
Worth knowing
Most complex workflows needed 2-3 refinements. The browser window must stay active, and the reviewer says not to use it for banking or financial transactions.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
Go through my unread emails in [Gmail or Outlook] from [time period] and sort them into: needs a reply, FYI, and ignore. For the ones that need a reply, draft a short response in my tone and save it as a draft without sending anything. Then give me a summary list of what you did, and pause and show me before sending, archiving, or deleting any message.
Original source: https://www.booststash.com/claude-in-chrome-review-2025/
